Native geometry is baked; groupTransform is validated Orca Web editing metadata rather than a native engine transform field. Geometry/cut/group fixtures slice successfully; painted facets and advanced metadata still prevent lossless general native roundtrips.

Four-layer native-source PA patterns and bounded speed×acceleration batches added, with complete calibration 3MF exports and imported fixed-path edit guards. Native nesting, extra plates, broader firmware/Bambu contexts and GUI/hardware acceptance remain open.

Native-source dovetail cuts and metadata are implemented with closed grouped fragments and independent motion comparisons. Material/override limits, camera-depth context and GUI acceptance remain open.
Automatic brim generation and native canvas editing now retain native frames and localized adhesion. Open-chain repair, native pixels and broader geometry remain incomplete.

PA pattern batches add bounded rectangular plates; selected/all exports preserve generated scripts and whole-scene validation permits benign plate switches. Native nesting, firmware breadth and physical measurement remain open.

Fresh GUI archives now retain two typed native visual material fields. Production-validated web roundtrip matches actualGUI cube G-code; auxiliary assets and all native editing metadata remain incomplete.

Native planar and surface text metadata, embedded shape SVG and separate build/component mesh precision frames survive bounded roundtrip. Topology rewrites require explicit metadata-loss consent. Actual native regeneration and GUI reopening remain outstanding.

Native plate normal/small/no-light/top PNG bytes and cover relations now survive unchanged exports; appearance signatures omit stale render assets after edits. Original pick buffers remain web-only because native object IDs are renumbered. General auxiliary assets, image regeneration and GUI reopening remain incomplete.

Opaque native Auxiliaries files, Unicode names, cover relationships and native attribution retain bytes through save/export. Category editing, bounded raster previews, rename/delete/undo and stale read protection are implemented. Cover generation and full GUI acceptance remain open.

A source-confirmed sole-volume native material normalization mismatch is fixed. Browser material edits synchronize exported parent material; multipart independence remains. Complete multimaterial/hardware acceptance remains open.

Imported native text regenerates through the pinned font/CGAL kernel with preserved native frames and typography, bounded worker lifecycle, explicit font selection, undo and paint-loss consent. Planar reference commands match exactly; per-glyph/new-native-text/SVG workflows and unchanged surface motion order remain incomplete.

Set as cover generates all three native PNGs using pinned wxWidgets interpolation and source crop sizing. Atomic edit/undo, source-byte preservation, covers/DesignerCover, bounded async API and cancellation are implemented. Fresh GUI capture and other native asset workflows remain open.

New text now uses the native font/triangulation/CGAL path, with planar or surface per-glyph contour placement. Unchanged editor sessions preserve original geometry/paint/history without regeneration. Exact saved-surface triangulation, direct placement gizmos and style workflows remain open.

Recognized Prusa3MF projects now use the pinned native GUI archive importer, retaining volume roles/painting/materials and local instance frames. Current catalog or embedded configuration is retained; native-ignored Prusa settings survive as bounded inactive source bytes. Direct and raw imports share a cancellable bounded queue.

Pinned NanoSVG/NSVGUtils and native emboss kernels now create and regenerate embedded SVG solids on a plane or selected surface. Source frames, no-op preservation, explicit paint-loss consent and Undo are tested. Native subpath selection, direct drag/style workflows and fresh GUI acceptance remain open.

Purge tables now preserve and edit N independent physical-nozzle matrices and multipliers, with native display/edit rounding. Slot edits and Prusa material expansion retain every existing table. Real H2D/J1/XL preset-variant resolution and independent multi-nozzle GUI capture remain open.

Copy/Paste/Clone use original native placement and part-frame rules, unchanged names, independent snapshots and bounded counts. Clone selects its final batch; Auto arrange creates a second native Undo step. All native millimeter 3MF meshes retain validated indexed source frames. Fill, shared-instance propagation, other clipboard contexts and complete native GUI acceptance remain open.

The original native JSON loader, Preset normalization and full_config now resolve selected printer/process/material contexts. Export retains inactive variants; effective UI/slicing validation uses physical-nozzle selections. H2D/J1 exact motion comparisons and real browser/native export pass. Custom saved active-value variant persistence, dedicated mapping UI and complete GUI/native user-preset behavior remain open.

Shared model edits now reconcile part geometry/settings/name/paint/height/text/brim metadata across linked instances before one history transaction. Local instance placement/deletion and native auto_drop are retained. Linked Cut and full native GUI behavior remain open.

New native Text/SVG and legacy text volumes inherit the imported ModelObject family when attached, including a single source instance. Independent text clears the family. A pending restored-project catalog now retains request ownership until restoration commits.

Native dependency lists/conditions now retain inherited versus explicit-empty values through JSON import, editor save and export. Trusted editor inspection permits repairing incompatible presets without weakening job enforcement. Native parent-diff setting inheritance and automatic reselection remain open.

The full combined M23 installed-native run completed221 passes,14 failures and2 cancellations. Native export timeouts, XL SIGBUS and strict same-input motion variability remain recorded without weakened assertions.

Cut to parts now uses original cut_mesh, tessellation and CutUtils methods with native instance reset. Exact cap geometry and linked family roundtrip are covered; full native gizmo, paint transfer, broader plate behavior and historical motion variability remain open.
